notes: PHASE-000 foundation is complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 remains in progress because its acceptance criterion is not yet satisfied: approved desktop calling applications have not consumed processed/bypass audio through an installed OS-visible VSN virtual microphone. The verified Windows foundation includes Rust audio contracts and bounded queues, deterministic device selection/reselection, bounded stream recovery, IAudioClient3 planning, event-driven WASAPI capture, sample decode/reframing, CaptureRuntime reopen recovery, IMMNotificationClient delivery, bounded virtual-mic staging/output, Rust/C++ transport ABI, aligned Interlocked cursor publication, deterministic shared-region geometry, real user-mode section mapping and a WDK-buildable driver control path. The caller-supplied-section CONNECT assumption was replaced by driver-owned CONNECT v2 in merge 3953069f468c46d744f30625b3696e5b12f03a77. The KMDF control-driver slice merged as b2761ad400d92c1d810751fabcf4b071a40dfb9c. Protocol v2 then added an aligned per-slot seqlock stamp and guarded ConsumeOneRingFrame; AI Native run 34541120876 and Windows run 34541120903 passed before merge 9c57207482bdc20ca5dc70a06cbb43c0cfa86741. The PortCls/WaveRT descriptor slice established a build-valid 48 kHz mono 32-bit IEEE-float single-capture-stream descriptor set; AI Native run 34542011551 and Windows run 34542011553 passed before merge da1b0543bcbfe63ff6a342690cab3b250057bbe2. The PortCls lifecycle/WaveRT stream-contract slice added compile/link references to PcInitializeAdapterDriver and PcAddAdapterDevice while keeping StartDevice fail-closed with STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED; AI Native run 34543128712 and Windows run 34543128651 passed before merge 78ef04bf86bf02b25b9da25ef401dc84f73f0f2b. The WDF control-device experiment merged as f084e4be4d7930830ca68948699c26e42fc036c1 after AI Native run 34543962499 and Windows run 34543962515, but Microsoft KMDF miniport guidance later established that framework control-device objects are not valid for the intended PortCls miniport architecture. PR #18 was therefore closed unmerged and the architecture was corrected in merge 2665954315b52d01b3e59b6fb283f0da2a053eed. The corrected raw WDM scaffold merged as e31e40c0a78dcdf99396ea8a0bf3648691416b35 after AI Native run 34545966880 and Windows run 34545966842. The next security slice then ported CONNECT/DISCONNECT/QUERY_STATUS to raw WDM IRP/PFILE_OBJECT semantics. The raw control device now enforces UserMode and dynamic FILE_READ_ACCESS|FILE_WRITE_ACCESS, consumes METHOD_BUFFERED requests only from Irp->AssociatedIrp.SystemBuffer with exact request/response sizing, copies CONNECT before writing the aliased response buffer, fences ownership by IoGetRequestorProcessId + exact current-stack PFILE_OBJECT + session generation, preserves driver-created requestor-context section creation with independent object reference/system-space mapping and immutable validated protocol geometry, exposes QUERY_STATUS through a stable cursor snapshot, and tears down on DISCONNECT, owning IRP_MJ_CLEANUP, scaffold deletion and creation errors under a PASSIVE-safe kernel mutex. AI Native Quality Gates run 34713202688 and Windows Audio Validation run 34713202712 both passed on implementation head f7c701eaf7b12c4ce7f6814f64ef9e4c9b04e417; the Windows run passed Rust compile/Clippy/tests, pinned WDK restore, the .sys build/WDK validation and the native C++ virtual-mic contract suite. PR #22 merged this verified slice as 6c395ef7cbd7afc5caa3daac506dee16073335fe. The raw WDM runtime remains deliberately disconnected from live DriverEntry. The next valid WU-002 action is to switch live initialization to the supported KMDF-miniport pattern: create the WDF driver with WdfDriverInitNoDispatchOverride and no framework AddDevice callback, call PcInitializeAdapterDriver so PortCls owns the class-driver dispatch path, then install the raw WDM CREATE/CLOSE/CLEANUP and DEVICE_CONTROL multiplexers after PortCls has installed its handlers, preserving PcDispatchIrp forwarding for every non-control device. The raw control DO should be created only after the PortCls/WDF initialization path is valid, and failure/unload cleanup must remain bounded. PortCls StartDevice remains fail-closed until real wave/topology miniports exist. Actual miniport registration, concrete IMiniportWaveRT stream scheduling bound to ConsumeOneRingFrame, INF/install/test-signing, endpoint enumeration, calling-app routing and controlled-hardware evidence remain pending. Paid provider usage, proprietary model training, production credentials/cloud spend and production deployment remain subject to applicable provider/data/compute/release gates. Multi-agent execution is still in degraded single-runtime mode because config/ai/agent-catalog.json has no verified attachable agents and config/coordination/supervisor-state.json has no live Supervisor; the requested 11-worker pool cannot be truthfully claimed until those identities are attached and leased through the canonical coordination protocol.
